text:
Maya: quick sync 1 ACME wants a hybrid commitment: part reserved Dedicated GPUs + a pool of consumable credits for burst on hosted. They want clear burn rates and rollover rules.
Ethan: key Q 1 are credits consumed at hosted rates or discounted committed rates? sales pushing discounted.
Rhea: product view 1 two levers: a) reserved compute priced monthly, b) consumable credits priced as per-token credits with tiered unit cost. Rollover makes accounting messy.
Tom: billing-bot: can implement credits with expiration + rollover flag. Need decisions: expiration window (30/90 days) and whether credits apply before or after invoice-level discounts.
Lina: legal/commercial: contract needs to state how credits interact with usage overage and refunds on downgrades. Also need audit trail for credit allocations.
Ethan: proposal: 1) credits priced at hosted rate * 0.9 for pilot customers, 2) credits expire after 90 days, 3) credits burn before paid commit, 4) rollover disabled for V1.
Maya: timeline ask 1 customer wants pilot by end of Q2. Is that feasible?
Tom: infra: largely billing-side; small API surface to attach org_credits_id to requests. Estimate 2w billing + 3d API + 2d docs.
Rhea: product: add console view for credit balance + projected burn. Also need a simple calculator for sales.
billing-bot: action recorded 1 create ticket BILL-4387 for credit engine; require audit logs.
Lina: legal to draft contract clause for credit expiry & credit usage precedence.
Maya: decision? greenlight pilot with no-rollover credits, 90d expiry, 10% discount, and credits applied before commit. Approve?
Ethan: approve.
Rhea: approve.
Tom: approve.
Lina: approve pending legal text.
Maya: ok. Action items: Maya -> finalize pilot spec; Tom -> billing API task; Rhea -> console mock; Lina -> legal clause. Tagging for roadmap sync. :white_check_mark:
